title: Agent-editable site checker report
description: What a checker such as `slipway doctor --format json` prints: the level a site reaches and each finding with its file and line. Defined in levels.md, "How a checker reports a level".

spec.description: The spec the site was checked against.

version.description: The spec version, as in tests.json.

generator.description: The site's generator in lowercase, such as `hugo`, or `unknown` when the checker could not tell.

level.description: The highest level reached, or null when an L0 MUST fails.

notRun.description: The tests the checker did not run, for a person to finish.

tests.description: Every test in tests.json, in its order, with how it ended.

reason.description: Why a test was not run, or how it passed in part.

findings.description: The findings of every failed test, in test order.

message.description: What is wrong, without the file and line.

in.description: The folder `file` is relative to. A finding on a built page that the source map covers is moved to `source`.

file.description: The file, relative to the folder `in` names, with forward slashes.

key.description: The config key, front-matter field, URL, or heading id the finding is about.

allowed.description: The values that would be valid.

fix.description: A change that would fix the finding, in words an agent can act on.

output.description: The built file the finding was found in, when `file` was moved to its source through the source map.

id.description: The test in tests.json the finding belongs to.

severity.description: `error` for a failed MUST, `warning` for a failed SHOULD.
